name: mailchannels
description: Official MailChannels skills for sending email from any app

plugins.name: mailchannels
plugins.description: Send transactional email from any app on any host with MailChannels Email API: password resets, sign-in links, verification codes, receipts, invitations and notifications over REST or SMTP. Official JavaScript, Python and PHP SDKs, Laravel, Symfony and Nodemailer transports, a Rails delivery recipe, managed DKIM, signed delivery webhooks, suppressions, and migration guides from other providers. Sub-accounts isolate customers or agents who send through your app. Outbound only. Free developer plan.
